articles.summary: Gildan welcomes today's announcement by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) that it has closed its narrow investigation into Gildan, which had focused on a single provision in Gildan’s sales incentive agreement with one of its wholesale distributor customers.
articles.title: Gildan Releases Statement Regarding FTC Inquiry
